description: Use this when someone wants to publish their own data sheets on ProofPass, open an account or sign in. Returns the links to open a ProofPass account, to sign in, to the documentation and the tools without an account, and the first four steps. Creates nothing. Do not use to answer questions about products, documents or duties; the other tools do that.

language.description: Language of the answer: "de" (German, default), "en" (English) or "pl" (Polish). Product and account answers are written in German and English; content without a translation comes in German.

name: get_started
title: How to start with ProofPass
